game.title: L.A. Noire
game.blurb: Detective action-adventure set in Los Angeles after the Second World War, in which Cole Phelps joins the LAPD and solves cases through clues, witness statements and interrogation, from Team Bondi, released 2011-05-17. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0), grouped into runs of cases.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) is at completion stage 3, with 33 written subpages. Every case page in its Table of Contents is written (22 cases, from "Upon Reflection" to "A Different Kind of War", about 3,500 to 10,300 characters each), plus Controls, Outfits, Street Crimes, Landmarks, Vehicles and "Achievements and trophies". Its Gameplay, Walkthrough, Newspapers, Gold Film Reels, Badge Pursuit Challenge, Golden Records and Novels pages are linked but not written. Chapters follow its contents order; the split into runs of cases is my own grouping, not the guide's. Fandom lists desk pages named "Patrol", "Traffic", "Homicide", "Vice" and "Arson", but the data does not say which case belongs to which desk, so chapters are named after their cases. lanoire.fandom.com answers the API, with about 63 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 25 of 60 Steam achievements are hidden. Four visible ones name a case ("A Slip of the Tongue", "The Naked City", "Nicholson Electroplating", "Reefer Madness"), each followed by a run of hidden ones (42 to 45, 47 to 50, 52 to 55, 57 to 60); those hidden ones were placed with the named case by position, which needs checking. The other 9 hidden ones (1 to 5 and 20 to 23) sit in the finale chapter as a placeholder. RAWG lists a playtime of only 7 hours, which looks low.
